# volcano_storage_bucket (Resource)

A named container for files within a project. Per-file public access is controlled separately via volcano_storage_object's is_public.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_storage_bucket" "avatars" {
  project_id         = volcano_project.example.id
  name               = "avatars"
  file_size_limit    = 2097152
  allowed_mime_types = ["image/png", "image/jpeg"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `allowed_mime_types` (List of String) Allowed MIME types. Omit to allow all types.
- `file_size_limit` (Number) Maximum file size in bytes. Omit for no limit.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_storage_bucket.avatars <project-id>,<bucket-name>
```
